newsitem.title: UK: POLL-Dresdner tops Reuters smaller company poll.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Dresdner tops Reuters smaller company poll.

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson was voted best broker for smaller company research product and service by fund managers on Tuesday.
The Reuters 1997 survey into smaller company research sales and trading, carried out by Tempest Consulting, showed Kleinwort leading Cazenove & Co in second place, with SBC Warburg third.
Kleinwort also came top in weighted rankings of all industry sector research by both fund managers and company finance directors.
Fund managers voted UBS Ltd and SBC Warburg second and third respectively, while finance directors placed HSBC James Capel and SBC Warburg second and third.
Best fund management group according to company finance directors was Shroder Investment Management, ahead of Aberforth Partners and M&G Group.
Andy Brough of Schroders won an award for best individual fund manager.
Best broker for primary execution was Cazenove & Co, and UBS Ltd best broker for secondary execution.
The survey covered responses from fund managers with 39 billion stg of funds invested in quoted UK small cap companies and from 273 of the 700 largest small cap companies by market value.
